name: Mary's | 200mg The Remedy Tincture | Relief 1:1 CBD:THC
description: Experience the soothing power of our Relief Tincture, crafted with a distinctive terpene blend of gut-protective Beta-Caryophyllene and antioxidant myrcene. Free from base flavors or colors, with a 1:1 CBD:THC ratio, this tincture offers gentle intoxicating relief for those with sensitivities.
